1
Veer Mar Gaye Ne Lal Mar Gaye Hoi Qaidan Zahra Jayi.
Bhain Ghazi Di Sir Nangay Haye Sham Bazar Che Aayi.
Har Welay Ayho Zainab Nu Safraan Wich Dard Sataway.
Zindan Di Aseeri Wich Yaad Ayho Aaway.
Aawan Welay Karbal Taun Naa Veer Di Qabar Banai.
Abbas Meri Chadar Nu Naizay Nal Laya Aye.
Tak Bhain Teri Te Ki Aj Wela Aaya Aye.
Main Parday Layi Sir Apne Karbal Di Rait Way Payi.
Shabeer Diyaan Akhiyaan V Band Hoiyaan Naizay Te.
Bhaina De Jadon Wekhay Pathraan De Waar Honday.
Wekh Ke Ghazi Aye Manzar Kayi Waar Shahadat Payi.
Haye Sham Diyaan Tang Galiyaan Wich Roway Te Kurlaway.
Namoos-e-Nabi Haan Main Ro Ro Ke Dasdi Jaway.
Aye Sab Qari Neziyaan Te Main Ujari De Ne Bhai.
 Saqlain Jiwein Chehray Nu Walaan Naal Chupaya Aye.
Tatheer Diyaan Paliyaan Ne Pardah Way Banaya.
Syeda Zahra Dhiyaan Koon Tehzeeb Way Khoob Sikhayi.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/veer-mar-gaye-ne-lal-mar-gaye-hoi-lyrics-2020-tajpoints-bebd32f729fcb5b5db67.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---',2)[2].strip().splitlines()
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---',2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert all(l.startswith('  ') for l in roman)
assert [l.strip().removesuffix('.').casefold() for l in old] == [l.strip().casefold() for l in roman]
assert roman[0].strip() == '1' and source[0] == '۱'
assert len(source) == len(roman) == 18
assert all(l and not l.endswith('.') and '\\u200c' not in l for l in source)
print('Verified 17 verses in each edition and unchanged Roman wording.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions contain the same 17 verses in one stanza.

Updated the language metadata to `Panjabi` / `pa-Arab` / `rtl` based on the verse grammar, removed `noUrdu`, and dropped the catalog suffix “Lyrics 2020” from the title. The reading “Aye Sab Qari” is uncertain and is rendered literally as `اے سب قاری`.
